description: Coins with the largest liquidations in the last hour or 24 hours, exchanges summed, with the long/short split (longShare ≥ 0.6 — longs are being wiped out, ≤ 0.4 — shorts). Read together with an extreme funding rate it shows a squeeze in progress. Coverage: exchange liquidation streams of Binance, OKX, Bitget, Gate, Aster and part of Bybit; Hyperliquid and Bitunix are not covered.
